channel.title: The Colorado Sun - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Colorado Sun (coloradosun.com)

item.title: Former Colorado state senator convicted of felonies for fabricating letters amid ethics investigation
item.description: Sonya Jaquez Lewis, a Boulder County Democrat, was convicted by a Denver jury of attempting to influence a public servant and forgery

item.title: Colorado Democrats want to expand the state’s red flag gun law, impose new restrictions on gun barrels
item.description: Senate Bill 4 would allow for the seizure of someone’s guns if their child, or a child in their household, is determined to be in danger of harming themself or others

item.title: Crisosto Apache named Colorado’s newest poet laureate
item.description: Apache succeeds Andrea Gibson, who served as poet laureate from 2023 until their death in July from ovarian cancer

item.title: Colorado lawmakers reverse course, approve funding for new prison beds
item.description: Days after rejecting the same request, lawmakers signed off on millions of dollars in prison bed funding as overcrowding pressures grow

item.title: Opinion: Colorado’s plan to cut sexual health education funding would erase real gains for rural students
item.description: The statewide program is a key element in Colorado’s commitment to support the mental health and well-being of our young people

item.title: Polis, top negotiator to travel to DC in bid to break impasse on Colorado River
item.description: Colorado negotiator talked top priorities, nonnegotiables at Colorado Water Congress conference

item.title: Colorado women earn 81 cents on every dollar earned by men, and child care costs are making it worse
item.description: National and state women’s advocacy groups are calling for changes in child care, job discrimination, maternal health care

item.title: Colorado now has 6 million people, even amid slowly population growth
item.description: But the state saw more folks move out of state than move in. The State Demography Office attributes the declines in net migration to migrants who left.

item.title: Colorado AG asks Trump administration to let Craig’s coal plant close as planned
item.description: A coalition of environmental groups led by the Sierra Club on Wednesday also formally challenged the Trump administration’s order for Craig

item.title: New signs warning of radioactive materials settle one Rocky Flats controversy — for now
item.description: Some neighbors and activist groups wanted tougher alerts about past plutonium contamination, and Westminster and Boulder County finally agreed
